items.text: Avant-garde jazz in four pieces, each over eight minutes long, the longest nearly twelve minutes.
items.why: Infobox "Genre: Avant-garde jazz"; four compositions at 9:20, 10:07, 11:43, 8:58 (the fifth entry is a CD bonus alternate take).

items.text: 21 May 1965, Van Gelder Studio, Englewood Cliffs, NJ
items.why: Infobox "Recorded: May 21, 1965"; "Studio: Van Gelder Studio, Englewood Cliffs, NJ".

items.text: Sam Rivers (tenor saxophone, soprano saxophone, flute), Freddie Hubbard (trumpet), Herbie Hancock (piano), Ron Carter (bass), Joe Chambers (drums)
items.why: Personnel lists exactly these five with these instruments.

items.text: Every piece on the record is by Sam Rivers.
items.why: Track listing: "All compositions by Sam Rivers."

items.text: The album runs 40 minutes and 8 seconds from start to finish.
The bonus alternate take on the CD reissue runs 9:04, a little longer than the 8:58 version.
items.why: "'Mellifluous Cacophony' - 8:58; 'Mellifluous Cacophony' [Alternate Take] - 9:04 Bonus track on CD reissue".

missed: That this is his second Blue Note album, where (AllMusic) he "fully embraced the avant-garde" but in a way that "wouldn't be upsetting or confusing to hard bop loyalists"; Rivers also plays soprano and flute, which could be a listen_for hint.
